# Crop production and sales

In this section, we harmonize the crop questions of the 2021 Annual, 2022 Annual, 2023 PDM and 2023 Annual surveys: for ten crops, the area cultivated, the quantity harvested and the quantity sold; the money earned from crop sales; the months of market gardening; post-harvest losses; and, from the 2022 PDM on, the months of needs that own production usually covers.

* **Units.** The areas and the post-harvest losses have no unit in any round. Each household gives one unit for all its harvested quantities and one for all its sold quantities. The unit codes differ by round and are put on one list:
  * 2021 Annual: 1 = kg, 2 = bundles, 3 = other, 4 = a code with no label;
  * 2022 Annual: the codes carry the labels of an area (1 = hectare, 2 = square metres, 3 = corde), which cannot be units of a quantity. They are kept as three separate codes (71 to 73), so that nothing is guessed;
  * 2023 PDM and Annual: 1 = kg, 2 = tonnes, 3 = grams.
* **Quantities are kept as reported, never converted.** In the 2022 Annual and 2023 PDM, the quantities recorded in "tonnes", "grams" or the area codes have the same medians as those in kg (about 200 to 400), so the unit codes look unreliable. Use the quantities in kg for comparisons.
* **Impossible values set to missing:** negative areas, quantities and losses, and months of market gardening above 12 (up to 2,000,000, apparently money amounts).

```{r 33 packages needed}
library(haven)
library(labelled)
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
```

```{r 33 remove environment variables}
rm(list = ls())
```

```{r 33 environment settings}
dir_input_data = "C:/Users/AHema/OneDrive - CGIAR/Desktop/WFP Resilience dataset/data/input_data/Chad"
dir_output_data = "C:/Users/AHema/OneDrive - CGIAR/Desktop/WFP Resilience dataset/data/output_data/Chad"
```

```{r 33 read harmonization excel file}
Chad_Harmonization_variables <- read_excel(paste0(dir_input_data, "/Chad_Harmonization_extension.xlsx"), sheet = "variables_harmonization") %>%
  dplyr::filter(Module == "Crops")
Chad_Harmonization_description <- read_excel(paste0(dir_input_data, "/Chad_Harmonization.xlsx"), sheet = "description")
Chad_Harmonization_ID <- read_excel(paste0(dir_input_data, "/Chad_Harmonization.xlsx"), sheet = "variables_harmonization") %>%
  dplyr::filter(NewVariable_Name == "ID")
```

```{r 33 data importation}
lst_data = Chad_Harmonization_description$Data
lst_test = Chad_Harmonization_description$Name
for (i in 1:length(lst_data)) {
  assign(lst_test[i], read_sav(paste0(dir_input_data, "/", lst_data[i])))
}
```

```{r 33 select and rename columns needed}
to_num <- function(z) { z <- zap_labels(z); if (is.character(z)) { z <- trimws(z); z[z == ""] <- NA; stopifnot(all(grepl("^-?[0-9.]+$", z[!is.na(z)]))) }; as.numeric(z) }
for (j in 1:length(lst_test)) {
  raw <- get(lst_test[j], envir = .GlobalEnv)
  df <- tibble::tibble(.rows = nrow(raw))
  id_var <- Chad_Harmonization_ID[[lst_test[j]]]
  df$ID <- if (is.na(id_var)) NA_character_ else { z <- zap_labels(raw[[id_var]]); if (is.numeric(z)) format(z, scientific = FALSE, trim = TRUE) else as.character(z) }
  for (i in 1:nrow(Chad_Harmonization_variables)) {
    v <- Chad_Harmonization_variables[[lst_test[j]]][i]
    df[[Chad_Harmonization_variables$NewVariable_Name[i]]] <- if (is.na(v)) NA_real_ else to_num(raw[[v]])
  }
  df$.round <- lst_test[j]
  assign(lst_test[j], df)
}
Chad_pdm_2022$ID = as.character(1:nrow(Chad_pdm_2022))
```

## Recoding

```{r}
vars <- Chad_Harmonization_variables$NewVariable_Name
units <- c("CrpHarvestUnit", "CrpSoldUnit")
unit_map <- list(Chad_ea_2021 = c(`1` = 1, `2` = 2, `3` = 5, `4` = 6),
                 Chad_ea_2022 = c(`1` = 71, `2` = 72, `3` = 73),
                 Chad_pdm_2023 = c(`1` = 1, `2` = 3, `3` = 4),
                 Chad_ea_2023 = c(`1` = 1, `2` = 3, `3` = 4))
for (r in names(unit_map)) {
  d <- get(r)
  for (u in units) {
    stopifnot(all(d[[u]] %in% c(as.numeric(names(unit_map[[r]])), NA)))
    d[[u]] <- unname(unit_map[[r]][as.character(d[[u]])])
  }
  assign(r, d)
}
df_Chad <- dplyr::bind_rows(mget(lst_test))

nonneg <- grep("^CrpArea_|^CrpHarvest_|^CrpSold_|^CrpPostHarvestLoss$|^CrpSalesIncome$|^CrpGardeningMonths$", vars, value = TRUE)
neg <- sapply(nonneg, function(v) sum(df_Chad[[v]] < 0, na.rm = TRUE))
print(neg[neg > 0])
for (v in nonneg) df_Chad[[v]][!is.na(df_Chad[[v]]) & df_Chad[[v]] < 0] <- NA
over12 <- !is.na(df_Chad$CrpGardeningMonths) & df_Chad$CrpGardeningMonths > 12
print(table(df_Chad$.round[over12]))
df_Chad$CrpGardeningMonths[over12] <- NA
print(table(df_Chad$CrpMonthsOwnProdUsual[df_Chad$CrpMonthsOwnProdUsual %% 1 != 0]))
stopifnot(all(is.na(df_Chad$CrpMonthsOwnProdUsual) | (df_Chad$CrpMonthsOwnProdUsual >= 0 & df_Chad$CrpMonthsOwnProdUsual <= 12)))

# Checks reported in the issue register, values left as reported:
crops <- sub("^CrpHarvest_", "", grep("^CrpHarvest_", vars, value = TRUE))
sold_more <- Reduce(`|`, lapply(crops, function(k) !is.na(df_Chad[[paste0("CrpSold_", k)]]) & !is.na(df_Chad[[paste0("CrpHarvest_", k)]]) &
  df_Chad$CrpHarvestUnit %in% 1 & df_Chad$CrpSoldUnit %in% 1 & df_Chad[[paste0("CrpSold_", k)]] > df_Chad[[paste0("CrpHarvest_", k)]]))
print(c("households selling more kg than they harvested of a crop", sum(sold_more)))
big_area <- Reduce(`|`, lapply(grep("^CrpArea_", vars, value = TRUE), function(v) !is.na(df_Chad[[v]]) & df_Chad[[v]] > 100))
print(c("households with a crop area above 100", sum(big_area)))
```

```{r}
df_Chad$CrpHarvestUnit <- labelled(df_Chad$CrpHarvestUnit, c("Kg" = 1, "Bundles" = 2, "Tonnes" = 3, "Grams" = 4, "Other" = 5, "Code with no label (2021 Annual)" = 6,
  "2022 Annual code 1 (labelled hectare)" = 71, "2022 Annual code 2 (labelled square metres)" = 72, "2022 Annual code 3 (labelled corde)" = 73))
df_Chad$CrpSoldUnit <- labelled(df_Chad$CrpSoldUnit, val_labels(df_Chad$CrpHarvestUnit))
for (i in 1:nrow(Chad_Harmonization_variables)) var_label(df_Chad[[Chad_Harmonization_variables$NewVariable_Name[i]]]) <- Chad_Harmonization_variables$Label[i]
var_label(df_Chad$ID) <- "Household ID"
```

## Export all data

```{r}
df_Chad <- df_Chad %>% dplyr::select(ID, all_of(vars))
haven::write_dta(df_Chad, paste0(dir_output_data, "/", "WFP_Chad_Crops.dta"))
```
